Fakultaet, Universitaet Bern. xxvii+905 pp. DOI 10.48620/94570, URN urn:nbn:ch:bel-bes-12243 (CC BY 4.0). downloaded from the Swiss National Library e-Helvetica deposit (bel-bes-12243/data/).

sources.note: Silent. Sec. 2.1 Phonologie (pp. 91-133) of the West Mewahang sketch treats consonant inventory, vowel inventory (6 vowels with phonemic length; p.102 short vowels in open syllables freely realised half-long to long), syllable structure/phonotactics (pp.105-106) and morphophonology; there is no section or sentence on word accent, stress or tone (a full-text search for stress/accent Akzent/Betonung/betont/Ton/prosod/stress). The only accent remarks are in Appendix C about Hodgson's 1857 diacritics, p.758: 'Die Bedeutung des Akzents, der von Hodgson reichlich verwendet wird, erschliesst sich ni…
